notes: An 'or' with maths over fields (20-day return vs 60-day return) cannot be split into separate parts, so both sides sit in one boolean formula.
RSI14 under 30 is taken as a plain hard cut with no uptrend gate, since the sentence does not ask for one; alone it can list falling knives.
A null on either side of the formula (short history or a gap in recent bars) means the name will not pass.

formulas.name: draft_ret_beats_or_rsi_low
formulas.description: The 20-day return is above the 60-day return, or RSI 14 is under 30
formulas.null_meaning: A return or the RSI is unknown (short history or a gap in recent bars)
